notes.title: Patch 1.07 is live
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25233280/da9a826b6d5aa0b614e07ac641e6b6cfc6b50a31.jpg

We've released patch 1.07 which mostly addresses stability, but also introduces the Shockwave Barrel Combo feature. Here are the details:


Shockwave combo: Drop a lightning bolt on explosive barrels to create a more powerful electric explosion, which has longer range and does more damage.
Fixed rare crash when units try to spawn crowds around themselves.
Lightning bolts no longer target fireworks, only explosive barrels.
Explosive barrels are slightly more powerful.
Misc interface tweaks.

notes.title: Skee-Boulder + Rankings Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25233280/ffbe70ef9c2b7a703b66b55371e28458e7d146b8.jpg

Update 1.06 is finally out. It took a little longer than expected, but version 1.06 brings several improvements and tweaks, and most importantly it adds the new Skee-Boulder mode and War Rankings.

About the two main additions:

Skee-Boulder:
Race head-to-head while destroying targets to earn points and be the first to reach the giant skee-ball ramp to multiply your score.

Ranked War matches:
War games now grant points to match winners. Players can climb the ranking ladder by defeating opponents in online games. Stronger opponents award more points. There's 5 ranks to achieve and a new Leaderboard that stores this info. Players that do not want to have their ranks displayed or compete for points can opt-out from the options menu. 

Other changes:

There's a bunch of other improvements and stability fixes, listed here:

Fixed occasional crash when winning an Obstacle Course online match.
Fixed rare online crash when building units.
Fixed lower half of towers and walls not having correct collision on client sometimes.
Fixed high speed collisions with destructible debris throwing the boulder off course.
Adjusted gamma slider range.
Fixed Jack-o'- Lantern boulder explosion not affecting units.
Fixed explosive boulders having a shorter build time after hitting the gate.
Added an achievement for landing in the highest multiplier in the Skee-Boulder ramp.
Added achievements for climbing to every War rank.  
Ranking information is displayed at online War matches and general interface.


Hope everyone enjoys this latest awesome update!

---------------------------
Update:

Hotfix #1: (1.06.1)
Fixed time trial leaderboards not preserving lowest time.

notes.title: October/Halloween Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25233280/169bc1ddcbfb3370af46c34cd3cd0761f7efb76d.jpg

The Halloween update has been released! With version 1.05 the Jack-o'-Lantern returns. Patch additionally has many fixes, improvements and balancing changes to the game. Full list of changes is here:

Added Jack-o'-Lantern boulder which can be selected outside of the campaign
Added two new Halloween themed flag banners.
Added one Halloween themed boulder paint.
Fixed a physics crash.
Addressed a GPU crash in DirectX11.
Tweaked lighting on the majority of the levels.
Tweaked stats on boulder 'skins' so every boulder has unique stats (no more clones).
Boulder stats are exhibited in numeric values in addition to the existing bar graphic. 
Cow boulder goes "Moo" when it falls out of bounds.
Mirror tips disappear after a brief moment (are not always visible).
Fixed exploit in Egypt level where players could skip half of the map with balloon boulders.
Removed usable tiles inside castles in Lviv.
Fixed projectiles going through units.
Fixed FOV working incorrectly during tutorial segment.
Forcing more save states to avoid losing data when exiting the game. 
Brightness bar slider has more subtle increments.


Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch 1.04 released
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25233280/5858fd2d0c1d2de4963fbbfded5478bac858029a.jpg

A new update has been released! Version 1.04 brings some fixes, improvements and balancing changes to the game. Full list of changes is here:

Added GPU crash fix. 
Fixed rare crash when selecting rematch in split-screen after destroying the enemy's gate.
Increased FOV ranges (50 to 130) which allows setting FOV better for 21:9 display settings.
Cannons have slightly less health and use up 3x3 tiles.
Phoenix tree regenerates tiles a bit slower.
Da Vinci tank cannons with slightly better knockback and damage. 
Lighter boulders take slightly less damage when falling off the course and heavier boulders take more.
Fixed bug where Gunpowder boulder rebuilds fast after striking the gate.

notes.title: Patch 1.03 is live
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25233280/da9a826b6d5aa0b614e07ac641e6b6cfc6b50a31.jpg

The first patch is out! Version 1.03 brings some important improvements, fixes and new features to the game.  Full list of changes is here:


Improved voice chat options. From the 'options' menu players can globally set voice chat preferences. Party menu now allows to mute yourself.
Ability to reset progress. 'Delete progress' button in options menu resets all the progress in the game.
Host can no longer exploit the 'kick' function. Kicking players is not available mid-way during a match.
'Joining game' blocker error fixed.
Better support for 21:9 resolution.
Extended window options. Players can now select 'borderless'.
Increased downscaling effect of knockback and damage when receiving multiple projectile shots.
Added walls in Lviv that prevent you from traversing the final section exclusively through the map border. 
Fixed leaderboards not updating properly when mouse-over is used.
Fixed Zoologist achievement (lightning is still not usable).
Small nerf to acceleration and jump for all 'Balloon' boulders.
Slightly nerfed impact resistance for Prehistoric Wheel (slows down more when breaking through destructibles).
Catapults rotate slightly faster.
Fixed a couple of crashes. 
Removed 'Friends Only' filter which was not working (will be restored in a future patch).


Note: Some new text strings are missing in German, French, Italian and Chinese (this will be fixed in the next patch).
